zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空將於2027年開航西雅圖至雅典與巴黎直飛航線
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空宣佈將於2027年春季開航西雅圖至雅典與巴黎航線
body: 阿拉斯加航空宣佈將於2027年春季起，開辦從西雅圖-塔科瑪國際機場（SEA）飛往雅典國際機場（ATH）以及巴黎夏爾·戴高樂機場（CDG）的直飛航線。其中，往返雅典的AS196航班預計於2027年5月12日首航，每週營運三班；往返巴黎的AS136航班則預計於2027年5月25日首航，每週營運五班。
兩條新跨大西洋航線均將採用波音787-9型客機執飛。機票已於2026年8月20日開賣。阿拉斯加航空執行長班·米尼庫奇（Ben Minicucci）表示，該公司正致力於在未來數年內，營運超過12條從西雅圖出發的國際長途航線。

en.title: Alaska Airlines to Launch Nonstop Seattle Flights to Athens and Paris in 2027
en.summary: Alaska Airlines will launch nonstop flights from Seattle to Athens and Paris starting in spring 2027.
body: Alaska Airlines has announced it will launch new nonstop service from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA) to both Athens International Airport (ATH)  and Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) in spring 2027. Flights to Athens, operated as flight AS196, will begin on May 12, 2027, with three weekly departures. Flights to Paris, designated as flight AS136, are scheduled to start on May 25, 2027, running five times per week.

Both transatlantic routes will be operated using the airline's Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner aircraft. Tickets for the new services were placed on sale on August 20, 2026. Alaska Airlines CEO Ben Minicucci noted that the carrier aims to expand its Seattle network to operate more than 12 international long-haul routes in the coming years.
